description:
I saw the RYOBI Framework Customizable Workbench kit at an event recently and I immediately knew I had to test it out. This build was also the perfect project to put my new Caveman Tools drill bit kit to work. Sign up for the drill bit kit waitlist 👉🏼https://cavemantools.com

Introducing The Ultimate Homeowner's Drill Bit Kit from @CavemanTools  

This Fall, my family and I are launching Caveman Tools, a tool company built for homeowners. 

We're setting out to solve real homeowner problems and create tools that make it easier for you to achieve professional results. 

First up the Ultimate Homeowner's Drill Bit Kit.

Everything you need to renovate and repair your home in one kit. I've created this kit to include the drill bits I've relied on in the past 10 years of teaching homeowners on Home RenoVision DIY. 

Instead of collecting multiple drill bit kits full of missing, duplicate, or barely used bits, we've built one organized kit that has all of the bits homeowners actually need
